title: Move files or folders to the Trash
summary: Use the `trash` command to move files or directories to the macOS Trash. This is a safer alternative to `rm` because you can restore items from the Trash later.
prerequisites: The `trash` command must be installed (often via Homebrew: `brew install trash`)
